source.index-missing.why: Set the Source folder and capture the saved project to queue indexing.
source.index-missing.source: Hand-written from the Source Passage read contract.

source.index-stale.why: Capture the saved project and wait for Source indexing to finish.
source.index-stale.source: Hand-written from the Source Passage read contract.

source.generation-changed.why: Start at the first page of the current generation.
source.generation-changed.source: Hand-written from the Source Passage read contract.

baseline.missing.why: No Baseline exists for this project, so there is nothing to compare against. Capture one first.
baseline.missing.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

baseline.unavailable.why: The saved copy of the project that the Baseline needs is not available, so this cannot be measured. Take a fresh Baseline.
baseline.unavailable.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.busy.why: Another Motif task holds this project, so it cannot be used yet. Wait about ten seconds.
project.busy.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

rejection-trace.request-invalid.why: The request is not one Motif can trace. Check the word, the cap on paths (1 to 64) and --at, then try again.
rejection-trace.request-invalid.source: Hand-written from the rejection-trace request check.

rejection-trace.unsupported.why: The pinned PanGloss cannot give this trace. Parsing is traced; generation and revision selectors are not available yet.
rejection-trace.unsupported.source: Hand-written from the rejection-trace capability check.

rejection-trace.capture-refused.why: PanGloss refused to capture the trace and said why. Read its reason, then change the request or the grammar.
rejection-trace.capture-refused.source: Hand-written from PanGloss's typed diagnostic error.

rejection-trace.malformed.why: PanGloss wrote a trace Motif cannot read. Update Motif and PanGloss together, then try again.

why-lost.request-invalid.why: The request is not one Motif can compare. Give one word, --project and --proposal with a Proposal id, and a cap on paths of 1 to 64.
why-lost.request-invalid.source: Hand-written from the why-lost request check.

why-lost.incomparable.why: The Baseline and the Trial copy were traced with grammar hashes that do not compare, so Motif will not diff them. Update Motif and PanGloss together, then try again.
why-lost.incomparable.source: Hand-written from the why-lost comparison check.

rejection-trace.capture-limit.why: The trace did not finish or was larger than Motif keeps. Lower the cap on paths and try again.
rejection-trace.capture-limit.source: Hand-written from the rejection-trace capture limit.

why-not.request-invalid.why: Motif cannot send this question. Give one word with no spaces and one to 16 candidates written like kib,ak|ik,ek; name every choice by morph id, or every choice by entry:msa guid, not both in one call.
why-not.request-invalid.source: Hand-written from the why-not request check.

why-not.parser-unsupported.why: The installed PanGloss cannot answer why-not: its --describe does not declare the why-not capability Motif reads. Install a PanGloss release that does, then try again.
why-not.parser-unsupported.source: Hand-written from the why-not capability check.

why-not.input-refused.why: PanGloss refused the question and said why, such as an unknown morph id or a guid that is not the morph's. Read its reason, correct the candidate, and try again.
why-not.input-refused.source: Hand-written from PanGloss's why-not input errors.

why-not.malformed.why: PanGloss wrote a why-not report Motif cannot use, or one that does not match the candidates asked. Update Motif and PanGloss together, then try again.
why-not.malformed.source: Hand-written from the why-not report reader.

why-not.unfinished.why: PanGloss did not finish the why-not question or wrote no report. Try fewer candidates or choices, then try again.
why-not.unfinished.source: Hand-written from the why-not run outcomes.

forms-explain.request-invalid.why: Motif cannot send this question. Name one root morpheme, or one word with --word, not both; give each --with morpheme as an entry guid, entry:msa, or a form in the lexicon.
forms-explain.request-invalid.source: Hand-written from the forms-explain request check.

forms-explain.parser-unsupported.why: The installed PanGloss cannot generate forms with a rule trace: its --describe does not declare interfaces.serveOps.generate. Install a PanGloss release after 0.27.0 that does (sillsdev/PanGloss#434), then try again.
forms-explain.parser-unsupported.source: Hand-written from the forms-explain capability check.

forms-explain.morpheme-unresolved.why: No entry in the project's saved copy matches the morpheme you named. Check its spelling, or name it by entry guid or entry:msa.
forms-explain.morpheme-unresolved.source: Hand-written from the forms-explain morpheme lookup.

forms-explain.morpheme-ambiguous.why: The morpheme you named matches more than one entry or analysis. The refusal lists them; name one as entry:msa and try again.
forms-explain.morpheme-ambiguous.source: Hand-written from the forms-explain morpheme lookup.

forms-explain.parser-refused.why: PanGloss refused the generate request and said why, such as an unknown entry or an analysis class it cannot generate from. Read its reason, correct the morpheme, and try again.
forms-explain.parser-refused.source: Hand-written from PanGloss's serve generate errors.

forms-explain.malformed.why: PanGloss's generate reply has a part Motif cannot read; the message names the field. This is a PanGloss reply-shape problem: report it to PanGloss with that field name and the grammar hash. Retrying or updating will not change it.

forms-explain.unfinished.why: The resident PanGloss failed, died or timed out before it answered. Try again; if it repeats, name fewer morphemes.
forms-explain.unfinished.source: Hand-written from the forms-explain run outcomes.

forms-explain.no-reading.why: PanGloss gave the word no analysis Motif can name in the lexicon, so there is nothing to generate from. Parse the word with motif parse --trace to see why.
forms-explain.no-reading.source: Hand-written from the forms-explain word path.

project.startup-busy.why: Wait for the Motif task using the project to finish, then repeat the command.
project.startup-busy.source: Hand-written from the project startup refusal.

project.in-use.why: FieldWorks has the project open, so Motif cannot change it. Ask the linguist to save and close it, then repeat this call.
project.in-use.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.registration-failed.why: Motif could not record the project because the worker root at {workerRoot} or the machine store at {machineStorePath} is not writable or valid. Fix them, or let any other writer to the store finish.
project.registration-failed.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

change.project-saving.why: FieldWorks is saving the project, so it cannot be changed this moment. Wait a few seconds.
change.project-saving.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.not-found.why: The project file is missing, so there is nothing to open. Tell the linguist; do not guess another path.
project.not-found.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

job.wait-timeout.why: The wait ended before a result was available.
job.wait-timeout.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

job.wait-cancelled.why: The caller stopped waiting before the outcome was confirmed.
job.wait-cancelled.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

job-wait-ended-cancelled.why: The job was cancelled. Start a new job if the work is still wanted.
job-wait-ended-cancelled.source: Hand-written from the terminal wait outcomes.

job-wait-ended.why: The job ended as {status}. Inspect the saved status or result for {jobId}.
job-wait-ended.source: Hand-written from the terminal wait outcomes.

job-wait-cleanup.why: The job ended as {status}. Ask the person to check its cleanup before starting replacement work.
job-wait-cleanup.source: Hand-written from the terminal wait outcomes.

job-wait-unconfirmed.why: Motif could not confirm that {jobId} ended. Use the job status tool to check its status before starting replacement work.
job-wait-unconfirmed.source: Hand-written from the terminal wait outcomes.

proposal.not-found.why: No Proposal has that id, so it cannot be used. List the Proposals that exist, then use one of those ids.
proposal.not-found.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

proposal.invalid-id.why: That is not a well-formed Proposal id, so it cannot be looked up. Use a proposalId a tool returned, or one from the Proposal list; do not type one.
proposal.invalid-id.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

draft.variant-component-required.why: The analysis has a part of speech, but the entry has no linked variant reference. Establish its main entry or sense before removing the empty sense; ask when the identity is uncertain.

draft.sense-analysis-content.why: The analysis has content beyond an allowed part of speech, so deleting it could lose information. Review the named field and keep the sense until its content is resolved.

draft.revision-conflict.why: The Draft changed after you last read it, so this change would overwrite newer work. Read the Draft again with its id, then retry.
draft.revision-conflict.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

job.dry-run-incomplete.why: The Dry Run did not complete, so the Draft has not been checked. Revise the Draft and run a new Dry Run.
job.dry-run-incomplete.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

store.other-project.why: The Motif file beside this project belongs to another project path: the project was copied, or the original was moved or renamed. Tell the linguist; do not retry and do not delete the file, because it may hold the only copy of that project's Proposals. While Motif is closed, move the '.motif.db' aside to give this project its own; its Proposals stay in that file and are not available here until it is put back beside the project it belongs to. Or copy the project without it.
store.other-project.source: Hand-written from the Motif store binding rules.

store.other-version.why: Motif's data for this project was made by another version of Motif, so this version cannot read it. If the refusal names an older schema (storeUpgradable), Motif upgrades it on open, after taking a backup it names; if you see this on a read, run motif store upgrade --project; never delete it. If it names a newer store (storeNewer), Motif will not reset or delete it: tell the linguist to install the newer Motif or restore a pre-upgrade backup with motif store restore. Do not retry.
store.other-version.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

store.upgrade-failed.why: Motif could not upgrade this project's older store, and it changed nothing: the store is as it was. The refusal names the backup taken first (backupPath) and the step that failed (failedStep). Tell the linguist; do not retry in a loop and do not delete the store. If failedStep is swap, opening the project again finishes the upgrade; otherwise the linguist can run motif store restore with backupPath.
store.upgrade-failed.source: Hand-written from the Motif store upgrade rules.

parse.already-running.why: A parse is already running for this project, so a second cannot start. Wait a minute.
parse.already-running.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

assess.collect-empty.why: Name at least one collector, or leave collect unset for the default. For example ParseTime, Correctness and ObjectTiming.
assess.collect-empty.source: Hand-written for the Assess collect option.

assess.out-of-memory.why: Motif or PanGloss ran out of memory, or PanGloss exceeded its memory ceiling. Nothing in the project is damaged. Assess fewer words or use fewer parser threads; when Motif runs out of memory, collect without ObjectTiming. Tell the linguist; do not retry unchanged.
assess.out-of-memory.source: Hand-written for the Assess memory bound.

assess.parser-killed.why: PanGloss was killed or terminated before the run completed. Partial output is not a completed Assessment. Tell the linguist; inspect system memory pressure and try fewer words or fewer parser threads before retrying.

assess.parser-memory-limit.why: The parser used more memory than Motif allows, so the run was stopped. Tell the linguist; do not retry unchanged.
assess.parser-memory-limit.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

assess.parser-unavailable.why: The parser is not installed here, so words cannot be assessed. Tell the linguist; evaluation tools cannot run.
assess.parser-unavailable.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

assess.timing-detail-selection.why: Full object timing needs an explicit Selection of no more than 2,000 words. Choose a smaller Selection or omit full object timing.

grammarcheck.parser-unavailable.why: The parser is not installed here, so the grammar cannot be checked. Tell the linguist; evaluation tools cannot run.
grammarcheck.parser-unavailable.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.writing-system-missing.why: A writing system the project needs is not set up here. This is a setup problem, not damaged data; tell the linguist what the message says to fix, and do not retry unchanged.
project.writing-system-missing.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

tool.unknown-argument.why: The call named an argument this tool does not have, so it was not run. Remove the argument the message names, or check the tool's input schema.
tool.unknown-argument.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

tool.missing-argument.why: The call left out an argument this tool requires, so it was not run. Add the argument the message names.
tool.missing-argument.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

tool.failed.why: The tool failed unexpectedly; the diagnostic log has 'tool {toolName} failed'. If it fails again after one repeat, stop and tell the linguist.
tool.failed.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

composer.goal-or-subject.why: A composer search needs exactly one of a goal or a Subject. Give a goal in a few words to rank composers, or a Subject id to list every composer that serves it.

composer.invalid-detail.why: The detail level must be concise or detailed. Leave it out for concise.

composer-no-match.why: Motif has no Composer for "{goal}" yet; the nearest Subject is {subject}.
composer-no-match.source: Hand-written for the composer search; {goal} and {subject} are filled in.

composer-no-match-no-subject.why: Motif has no Composer for "{goal}" yet.
composer-no-match-no-subject.source: Hand-written for the composer search; {goal} is filled in.

composer-no-match-next.why: Tell the person what is missing, in these words: {missing} Do not stage a nearby Composer as a stand-in for it.
composer-no-match-next.source: Hand-written for the composer search; {missing} is the sentence above.

composer.unknown-subject.why: No composer serves that Subject. Search by goal to find the right composer, or use one of the Subject ids the search lists.

assess.words-ambiguous.why: Give either inline words or a words file. Remove one of words and wordsFile, then repeat the call.

assess.words-file-empty.why: The words file at {wordsFile} has no words after blank lines are removed. Write one word per line, save the file, then repeat the call.

assess.words-file-unreadable.why: The words file at {wordsFile} could not be read. Check the path and read access, or choose a readable file, then repeat the call.

assess.words-file-too-large.why: The words file at {wordsFile} exceeds 8 MiB, including any initial UTF-8 signature. Split it into smaller word lists, then repeat the call for each file.

assess.words-file-bad-row.why: A line of the words file at {wordsFile} is not a word, or a word and a count. Write one word per line, optionally followed by a tab and a whole-number count, with no header line, then repeat the call.

assess.words-file-not-text.why: The words file at {wordsFile} must be valid UTF-8 text without NUL bytes. Save it as UTF-8 with one word per line, then repeat the call.

assess.words-multi-word.why: A word list line holds more than one word. Put each word on its own line with no spaces, then repeat the call.

variant.invalid-reference.why: Choose an existing variant reference owned by an entry.
variant.invalid-reference.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

variant.invalid-component.why: Choose an existing main entry or sense as the component.
variant.invalid-component.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

variant.invalid-type.why: Choose a type from the project’s variant types list.
variant.invalid-type.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

variant.invalid-entry.why: Choose an existing entry, or an entry created earlier in this Draft, as the entry to make a variant.
variant.invalid-entry.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

variant.already-linked.why: This entry is already a variant of that entry or sense. To change the variant type, use compose-link-variant on the existing variant reference.
variant.already-linked.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

variant.self-link.why: A variant cannot link to itself. Choose a different main entry or sense.
variant.self-link.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

variant.cycle.why: This link would create a cycle. Choose a main entry or sense outside the variant chain.
variant.cycle.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

adhoc-prohibition.invalid-morpheme.why: Choose morphemes that exist: the grammatical analysis (MSA) of an entry in the project or created earlier in this Draft.
adhoc-prohibition.invalid-morpheme.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

adhoc-prohibition.invalid-allomorph.why: Choose allomorphs that exist: a lexeme form or alternate form of an entry in the project or created earlier in this Draft.
adhoc-prohibition.invalid-allomorph.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

adhoc-prohibition.self.why: The first morpheme or allomorph is also in the rest. A rule against itself bans it from every word, or does nothing, so choose a different one for the rest.
adhoc-prohibition.self.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

adhoc-prohibition.duplicate.why: This prohibition already exists in the project or earlier in this Draft. To turn an existing one off or on, use compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition.
adhoc-prohibition.duplicate.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

adhoc-prohibition.no-morphology-data.why: The project has no morphology data to hold an ad hoc prohibition. Open it once in FieldWorks, then compose again.
adhoc-prohibition.no-morphology-data.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

compound-rule.invalid-category.why: Choose categories that exist: a part of speech in the project or created earlier in this Draft. Find ids with the grammar reading commands.
compound-rule.invalid-category.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

compound-rule.duplicate.why: This compound rule already exists in the project or earlier in this Draft. To turn an existing one off or on, use compose-edit-compound-rule.
compound-rule.duplicate.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

compound-rule.no-morphology-data.why: The project has no morphology data to hold a compound rule. Open it once in FieldWorks, then compose again.
compound-rule.no-morphology-data.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

affix-max-apps.invalid-count.why: An affix repeat count is a whole number from 1 to 3. 1 is the default and removes the setting; more than 1 lets the parser apply that affix more than once in a word, which multiplies its work, so keep it as low as the language needs.
affix-max-apps.invalid-count.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

affix-max-apps.not-affix-msa.why: The repeat count belongs to an affix's morphosyntactic analysis (inflectional, derivational or unclassified affix), not to an entry, sense, allomorph or stem analysis. Read the entry to find its analysis id, then compose again.
affix-max-apps.not-affix-msa.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

affix-max-apps.stale.why: The project's repeat count for this affix is no longer the one the intent expected. Read it again, then compose with the current value as expectedMaxApps.
affix-max-apps.stale.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

variant.stale-reference.why: The variant reference changed. Compose the link again against the current project.
variant.stale-reference.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

morph-type.stale-source.why: The form's morph type changed after this edit was composed. Inspect the form and compose the edit again.
morph-type.stale-source.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

text-notes.stale-source.why: The Notes of a segment changed after this edit was composed. Inspect the segment and compose the edit again.
text-notes.stale-source.source: Hand-written for the Text Note edit.

clitic-attachment.not-clitic.why: Attaches to Categories can be edited here only on a stem analysis of a proclitic, enclitic or clitic entry. Change the form's morph type first, in the same Draft if needed.
clitic-attachment.not-clitic.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

clitic-attachment.invalid-category.why: Every category must be a part of speech in this project. Read the project's parts of speech and compose the edit again.
clitic-attachment.invalid-category.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

rule-notation.context-in-use.why: A context this change deletes is also used by another object since the change was composed. Nothing was deleted; read the rule again and compose the change again.
rule-notation.context-in-use.source: Hand-written from the Motif record import refusal advice.

clitic-attachment.stale-source.why: The clitic's Attaches to Categories changed after this edit was composed. Read the current set and compose the edit again.
clitic-attachment.stale-source.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

morph-type.incompatible-family.why: This edit supports only a stem form changing between stem-family morph types. Changing between stem and affix needs a compatible analysis and a different authoring path.
morph-type.incompatible-family.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

proposal.evidence-retained.why: The Proposal's Trial results are still pinned, kept as current evidence, or cited by another Proposal's report, so it was not deleted and nothing changed. Release the pin or report that keeps them, then delete it again.

draft.authored-content.why: This Draft has a Rationale or Comments, so empty-draft cleanup keeps it. Keep the authored discussion, or discard this specific Draft deliberately with discard-draft.
draft.authored-content.source: Authored from the empty-draft cleanup contract.

draft.evidence-retained.why: The Draft's Trial results are still pinned, kept as current evidence, or cited by another Proposal's report, so it was not discarded and nothing changed. Release what keeps them, then discard it again.

draft.retained-by-example-set.why: A saved phonology Example Set cites this Draft, so it was not discarded and nothing changed. Delete the Example Set first, or keep the Draft.

draft.discard-pending-changes.why: The pending-changes Draft holds a person's unapplied changes, so the CLI did not discard it and nothing changed. Apply or discard it in the window.

command.autonomous-required.why: This command is for an Autonomous-mode run. Set MOTIF_AUTONOMOUS=1 or pass --autonomous, then run it again. It is never an MCP tool.

draft.trial-running.why: A Trial of this Draft is still running, so it was not discarded and nothing changed. Wait for the Trial to finish, then discard the Draft.

difference.proposal-decided.why: The Proposal has been decided, so its word detail is gone and a new comparison would not be kept. Read the saved summary with difference show instead.

difference.unreadable.why: Every saved comparison of the Proposal is damaged, so none can be shown. The refusal names each by Text, reference and time; run difference produce for one of them to make it again.

source.list-ambiguous.why: More than one possibility list in the project is named "Motif Sources", so Motif cannot choose one. Rename or remove all but one in FieldWorks.

source.not-found.why: The project's Source list has no Source with that id. List the Sources to see the ids.

source.id-invalid.why: A Source id is needed and has no spaces, for example WEB. A new id may not differ from an existing id only by case.

source.ref-invalid.why: A chapter is a book and a chapter number, for example MAT 5.

source.folder-missing.why: The folder named for the Source does not exist on this machine, or the recorded folder has gone. Give an existing Paratext project folder.

source.chapter-not-in-source.why: The Source's Paratext text on this machine has no such chapter, so it cannot be the Current chapter. Place the chapter first with source where.

source.id-in-use.why: A Source with that id is already in the list or staged in the pending changes. Choose another id, or change that Source.

source.id-removed.why: A removed Source has that id, and an id is never reused. Restore that Source instead.

source.context-invalid.why: The Context is not a valid range list in the Source's versification, for example GEN-ROM; 1CO 13-15. The refusal says what is wrong. To change the versification and the Context together, set the Context first.

source.versification-unknown.why: The versification is not one of the built-in names. The refusal lists the names that are allowed.

source.kind-unsupported.why: Only a Paratext Source can be added so far. A corpus Source is planned but not built.

source.ai-needs-proposal.why: An AI may not edit Sources in the pending changes, which hold a person's own Save. Start a Proposal with motif_start_proposal, compose the Source edits in that Draft, and Finalize it for a person to review and Apply.
source.ai-needs-proposal.source: Hand-written from the request for Motif Sources.

source.occurrence-not-found.why: The Source text has no word at that location. Read the Passage with source passage to see the locations, such as MAT 5:3#2.

source.occurrence-not-eligible.why: The word at that location has no letter, so it has no analysis to approve.

source.analysis-mismatch.why: The analysis belongs to a different wordform than the word at that location. Choose an analysis of the same wordform.

source.analysis-needed.why: Approving needs either a stored analysis, or a parser reading together with its wordform. Give one of them.

source.wordform-missing.why: The wordform for that parser reading is not in the FieldWorks project, so its analysis cannot be added. Add the wordform first.
